lines.text: Hang in there, almost the weekend!

data.define: Used to encourage someone during a hard time.

example.text: Hang in there, almost the weekend!

misuse.text: Don't say 'hang in there' about hanging laundry.
misuse.why: It means keep going through hard times.

publish.title: What does "hang in there" mean?
publish.value: Hang in there = Keep going, don't quit. Example: "Hang in there, almost the weekend!" (casual English).
